_doc: EN locale override. Merged by id with data/parcours.json: only the fields present here are translated; anything missing falls back to fr. This file is the worked example of the i18n mechanism (décision n°5) — not a full translation.

p-decouvrir-vc.title: VC, no bullshit
p-decouvrir-vc.hook: In 1 hour, understand how money flows from savings to founders — and why 9 startups out of 10 must die for the model to work.
p-decouvrir-vc.goal: Name the players (LP, GP, business angel), grasp the power law and the grammar of stages.
outcomes: Tell LP, GP and business angel apart
Explain the power law in your own words
Place a startup from pre-seed to Series C

p-entretien-analyst.title: Ace the Analyst interview
p-entretien-analyst.hook: Pass the case study and the deal memo: a clear, defensible invest/pass call under time pressure.

p-levee-fonds-lp.title: Raise a VC Fund (LPs & Institutions)
p-levee-fonds-lp.hook: From the first pitch to operational due diligence: how to convince fund of funds, insurers, and family offices to back your thesis.
p-levee-fonds-lp.goal: Master the VC fundraising process (PPM, data room, GP pitch) and understand the expectations and due diligence of Limited Partners (LPs).
outcomes: Differentiate the constraints and expectations of various LPs (insurers, fund of funds, family offices)
Compute a fund's management budget and model LP returns (waterfall)
Structure a convincing GP Pitch Deck and Private Placement Memorandum (PPM)
Anticipate operational due diligence and LP reference checks
Target key LPs in the French ecosystem (Bpifrance, family offices) and learn how to convince them

p-term-sheet.title: Decode a Term Sheet
outcomes: Master the specificities of French market standards (Galion / France Invest)
